Accordion.name: Accordion
Accordion.purpose: Sections that expand and collapse under their titles: FAQs, long settings. Children are the section contents, one per item, in order.

multiple.description: false: opening one closes the others

Alert.name: Alert
Alert.purpose: Inline message about the current screen: info, success, warning or error. Not a toast.

AvailabilityCalendar.name: AvailabilityCalendar
AvailabilityCalendar.purpose: A month grid showing which days are available, limited, booked or closed, with an optional price per day. Pressing a day lets the screen start a booking.

days.description: days not listed are shown as available without a price

selectedStart.description: ISO date, start of the highlighted range

selectedEnd.description: ISO date, end of the highlighted range

min.description: earliest month that can be shown, "YYYY-MM"

max.description: latest month that can be shown, "YYYY-MM"

legend.description: when given, a legend with these labels is shown under the grid

dayPress.description: ISO date of a pressed available or limited day

Avatar.name: Avatar
Avatar.purpose: Picture of a person or account, falling back to initials.

name.description: person or account name: used for initials and the accessible name

Badge.name: Badge
Badge.purpose: Small status label (e.g. "Holo", "Out of stock"). Not interactive.

BarChart.name: BarChart
BarChart.purpose: Compare a value across categories (orders per set).

summary.description: one sentence stating what the chart shows

BottomNav.name: BottomNav
BottomNav.purpose: The app's 3–5 top-level destinations at the bottom of the screen on phones. For views inside one screen use Tabs; on wide screens use Sidebar.

Breadcrumbs.name: Breadcrumbs
Breadcrumbs.purpose: Where the current screen sits in a hierarchy (Home › Sets › Base Set). The last item is the current screen.

Button.name: Button
Button.purpose: Triggers an action. Not for navigation to another screen — use Link.

icon.description: icon name shown before the label

Card.name: Card
Card.purpose: Bordered surface grouping related content. Optionally pressable as a whole.

pressable.description: whole card acts as one target and emits press

Carousel.name: Carousel
Carousel.purpose: One slide at a time from a small set (photos of one card, onboarding). Children are the slides.

label.description: accessible name of the carousel, e.g. "Card photos"

Checkbox.name: Checkbox
Checkbox.purpose: Boolean choice with a label. For a single on/off setting that applies immediately, use Switch.

ChipGroup.name: ChipGroup
ChipGroup.purpose: Toggle chips for quick filters or picking a few options ("Holo", "Rare", "Under $10"). For removable active filters use Tag; for switching views use SegmentedControl.

multiple.description: false: at most one selected, pressing it again clears it

wrap.description: false: one row that scrolls sideways

Combobox.name: Combobox
Combobox.purpose: Type to filter a long list, then pick one option (country, city, card name). For ≤ 15 fixed options use Select.

value.description: value of the chosen option, "" for none

options.description: already filtered for query by the screen

loading.description: options are being fetched for query

emptyText.description: shown when query is not empty and there are no options

search.description: query changed; the screen filters or fetches options

ConfirmDialog.name: ConfirmDialog
ConfirmDialog.purpose: Asks the user to confirm or cancel one consequential action ("Delete this order?"). For other content in a dialog use Modal.

confirmLabel.description: names the action, e.g. "Delete order" — not "OK"

cancel.description: cancel button, Escape or backdrop press

Container.name: Container
Container.purpose: Constrains content width and centers it on wide screens; adds horizontal page padding on narrow screens. One per screen, at the top of the tree.

DatePicker.name: DatePicker
DatePicker.purpose: Pick one calendar date. Values are ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD); the component shows them in the user's locale.

DateRangePicker.name: DateRangePicker
DateRangePicker.purpose: Pick a start and an end date (check-in / check-out, a date range filter). Values are ISO dates; the component shows them in the user's locale. For one date use DatePicker.

disabledDates.description: ISO dates that cannot be picked and that a range may not cross (booked nights)

summary.description: pre-formatted, shown under the field, e.g. "3 nights"

change.description: a complete range; both are ISO dates

DescriptionList.name: DescriptionList
DescriptionList.purpose: Label–value pairs about one thing: order details, card specs, profile facts.

layout.description: inline: label and value on one row; stacked: label above value

Divider.name: Divider
Divider.purpose: Thin separating line between groups of content.

Drawer.name: Drawer
Drawer.purpose: Panel that slides over the screen from a side, or from the bottom as a sheet: filters, a cart preview, extra options. For a blocking question use ConfirmDialog.

close.description: close control, Escape, backdrop press or swipe away

EmptyState.name: EmptyState
EmptyState.purpose: Shown in place of a list or result that has nothing to show. Explains why and offers one next step.

actionLabel.description: when present, a primary Button with this label is shown

FileUpload.name: FileUpload
FileUpload.purpose: Choose one or more files to attach, and see and remove what was chosen.

select.description: the user chose files; the platform file objects are handed to the handler in code

remove.description: name of the file to remove

FloatingActionButton.name: FloatingActionButton
FloatingActionButton.purpose: The one main action of a screen, floating over the content at the bottom corner ("New order", "+"). At most one per screen; for other actions use Button.

label.description: accessible name; shown next to the icon when extended

icon.description: icon name from the project set, e.g. "plus"

extended.description: show the label next to the icon

FormField.name: FormField
FormField.purpose: One label, hint and error shared by several related controls (an address, a date range, a phone with country code). A single control already has its own label — do not wrap it.

error.description: when present the group is in error state and this text is shown

direction.description: how the controls inside are laid out

Grid.name: Grid
Grid.purpose: Responsive grid of equal-width cells. Use for product/card listings. Not for tabular data — use Table.

minItemWidth.description: cells are at least this wide (px); column count follows from available width

Heading.name: Heading
Heading.purpose: Section or page title. Level is semantic (document outline), size is visual.

level.description: semantic level; exactly one level 1 per screen

HorizontalScroll.name: HorizontalScroll
HorizontalScroll.purpose: A row of items that scrolls sideways ("New arrivals", "Recently viewed"). Several items are visible at once; for one slide at a time use Carousel.

label.description: accessible name of the row, usually the section title

itemWidth.description: fixed width of every item in logical pixels; omitted = each item keeps its own width

snap.description: scrolling settles on an item edge

showArrows.description: previous / next controls on pointer devices

Icon.name: Icon
Icon.purpose: A single icon from the project icon set. Decorative unless label is given. For a pressable icon use IconButton.

name.description: icon name from the project set, e.g. "cart", "star"

label.description: when present the icon carries meaning and this is its accessible name

IconButton.name: IconButton
IconButton.purpose: Compact button showing only an icon. Requires an accessible label.

badge.description: pre-formatted count shown on the icon, e.g. "3"; "" shows a dot; omitted = no badge

Image.name: Image
Image.purpose: Displays an image with a fixed aspect ratio and a placeholder while loading.

ImageViewer.name: ImageViewer
ImageViewer.purpose: Full-screen view of one or more images with zoom and swipe (product photos, a card scan). Opened from an Image the user pressed.

close.description: close control, Escape, or swipe down

InfiniteScroll.name: InfiniteScroll
InfiniteScroll.purpose: Loads the next page when the user scrolls near the end of a long list or grid. Children are the list content. For numbered pages use Pagination.

loadMoreLabel.description: text of the fallback button, e.g. "Load more cards"

endText.description: shown when hasMore is false, e.g. "You have seen everything"

Inline.name: Inline
Inline.purpose: Horizontal arrangement of children with a consistent gap. Wraps onto new lines when out of room unless wrap is false.

Input.name: Input
Input.purpose: Single-line text entry with label, optional hint and error.

error.description: when present the field is in error state and this text is shown

revealLabel.description: type=password: accessible name of the show / hide control, e.g. "Show password"

LineChart.name: LineChart
LineChart.purpose: Trend of one or more series over an ordered axis (sales per day).

summary.description: one sentence stating what the chart shows, for screen readers and as a fallback

showLegend.description: only shown with more than one series

Link.name: Link
Link.purpose: Navigates to another screen. Not for actions that change data — use Button.

variant.description: inline sits in running text; standalone is a block-level nav item

press.description: the flow decides where it goes; the component never knows a route

List.name: List
List.purpose: Vertical list of ListItem rows (optionally wrapped in SwipeActions) separated by dividers. For free-form children use Stack.

ListItem.name: ListItem
ListItem.purpose: One row in a List: title, optional subtitle and trailing text, optionally pressable.

Menu.name: Menu
Menu.purpose: A short list of actions opened from a button ("⋯" more actions). For choosing a value use Select.

label.description: accessible name of the menu, e.g. "Card actions"

align.description: which edge of the trigger the menu lines up with

Modal.name: Modal
Modal.purpose: Blocking dialog over the current screen. For confirming one action use ConfirmDialog; for a side panel or sheet use Drawer; for non-blocking messages use Alert or Toast.

close.description: emitted by the close control, Escape, and backdrop press

NumberInput.name: NumberInput
NumberInput.purpose: Exact whole or decimal number with minus and plus controls: quantity, guests, age.

Pagination.name: Pagination
Pagination.purpose: Move between pages of a long list.

PieChart.name: PieChart
PieChart.purpose: Share of a whole across a few (2–6) parts. For more parts or comparisons use BarChart.

summary.description: one sentence stating what the chart shows

centerLabel.description: text in the donut hole, e.g. a total

PinInput.name: PinInput
PinInput.purpose: One-time code or PIN split into boxes (SMS verification, 2FA).

ProgressBar.name: ProgressBar
ProgressBar.purpose: How far a task has got (upload, profile completion). Omit value when the amount is unknown.

PullToRefresh.name: PullToRefresh
PullToRefresh.purpose: Lets the user reload a scrolling list by pulling it down on touch screens. Children are the scrolling content.

label.description: accessible name of the refresh action, e.g. "Refresh cards"

RadioGroup.name: RadioGroup
RadioGroup.purpose: Pick exactly one of 2–6 visible options, e.g. shipping speed. For more options use Select; for switching views use SegmentedControl.

Rating.name: Rating
Rating.purpose: Show or choose a score of 1–max stars. readOnly for showing an average.

label.description: accessible name, and visible label when not readOnly

RichText.name: RichText
RichText.purpose: A block of formatted text written in a small Markdown subset: product descriptions, terms, help text. For a single plain line use Text.

link.description: url of a pressed link; the screen decides what to open

SearchBox.name: SearchBox
SearchBox.purpose: Text search with a search icon and a clear control. Emits search on submit, not on every keystroke.

SectionHeader.name: SectionHeader
SectionHeader.purpose: Title of a section on a screen, with an optional trailing action ("New arrivals" · "See all").

SegmentedControl.name: SegmentedControl
SegmentedControl.purpose: Switch between 2–5 closely related views or modes in place (Grid / List, Day / Week). For content sections use Tabs; for a form choice use RadioGroup.

Select.name: Select
Select.purpose: Pick one option from a short list (≤ 15). For longer lists use SearchBox with results.

Sidebar.name: Sidebar
Sidebar.purpose: Vertical list of top-level destinations on wide screens (dashboards, admin). On phones use BottomNav or a Drawer.

section.description: heading this item is grouped under

SiteFooter.name: SiteFooter
SiteFooter.purpose: The footer shared by every page: columns of links, contact or social links, and the legal line. It stacks on narrow screens.

description.description: one or two sentences under the brand

navigate.description: value of a pressed link or social button

SiteHeader.name: SiteHeader
SiteHeader.purpose: The header shared by every page of a site or app: brand, main links and account actions. It adapts to narrow screens with a menu. For the title bar of one screen use TopBar.

brand.description: site or app name, also the accessible name of the home link

logo.description: logo image src; the brand text is still the accessible name

menuLabel.description: accessible name of the narrow-screen menu button, e.g. "Menu"

sticky.description: stays at the top while the page scrolls

Skeleton.name: Skeleton
Skeleton.purpose: Loading placeholder shaped like the content it stands in for.

Slider.name: Slider
Slider.purpose: Choose a number in a range by dragging, where the exact value matters less than the position (price filter, volume). For exact numbers use NumberInput.

valueLabel.description: pre-formatted value shown next to the label, e.g. "$40"

Spacer.name: Spacer
Spacer.purpose: Empty space. Inside Inline with justify=start it pushes following siblings to the far end when grow is true.

Spinner.name: Spinner
Spinner.purpose: Indeterminate activity indicator for waits under a few seconds. For content that is loading use Skeleton; for known progress use ProgressBar.

Stack.name: Stack
Stack.purpose: Vertical arrangement of children with a consistent gap. Use for page sections and form fields. Not for horizontal rows — use Inline.

Stat.name: Stat
Stat.purpose: One labelled figure, e.g. "Total · $124.00". Use in a Grid or Inline for KPI rows.

value.description: pre-formatted; the component never formats numbers or currency

Stepper.name: Stepper
Stepper.purpose: Progress through a fixed sequence of steps (checkout, onboarding). Shows the steps; each step's content is the rest of the screen.

press.description: index of a pressed completed step

SwipeActions.name: SwipeActions
SwipeActions.purpose: Reveals one or two actions when a row is swiped sideways (delete, archive). Wraps one ListItem or Card.

actions.description: 1–2 actions, shown on the trailing side

fullSwipe.description: swiping all the way runs the first action

Switch.name: Switch
Switch.purpose: On/off setting that takes effect immediately (notifications, dark mode). For a choice confirmed later with a submit, use Checkbox.

Table.name: Table
Table.purpose: Rows and columns of comparable records (orders, users). For a simple list of things use List.

cells.description: pre-formatted, one per column, in column order

emptyText.description: shown in place of the rows when there are none

sort.description: key of the column pressed; the screen decides the new order

Tabs.name: Tabs
Tabs.purpose: Switch between views within the same screen. For moving between screens use the flow and TopBar/BottomNav.

Tag.name: Tag
Tag.purpose: Removable chip, e.g. an active filter. For non-interactive labels use Badge.

Text.name: Text
Text.purpose: Body text. Not for headings — use Heading.

Textarea.name: Textarea
Textarea.purpose: Multi-line text entry: notes, messages, addresses. For one line use Input.

rows.description: visible lines before it scrolls or grows

autoGrow.description: grow with the content up to 10 lines

Timeline.name: Timeline
Timeline.purpose: Events in time order: order tracking, activity history.

Toast.name: Toast
Toast.purpose: Short, non-blocking confirmation that something happened ("Added to cart"), optionally with one undo-style action. For messages that must stay on screen use Alert.

duration.description: milliseconds before it closes by itself; 0 = stays until closed

Tooltip.name: Tooltip
Tooltip.purpose: Brief extra hint for the one element inside it, typically an IconButton. Never the only place important information lives.

TopBar.name: TopBar
TopBar.purpose: Screen header: title, optional back control, optional actions. One per screen, first child of the Container or root.

actions.description: each renders as an IconButton; action is the action name emitted through the actionPress event

actionPress.description: action name from the actions prop

Video.name: Video
Video.purpose: Plays a video file with the platform controls.

PriceTag.name: PriceTag
PriceTag.purpose: TODO: what it is for, and what not to use it for.
